choices.text: Tighnari, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #Ah, I didn't expect to see you here, {NICKNAME}. Thank you for the envelope — it's lovely.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno and I have had a great time. We ate a lot of delicious food and bought quite a few gifts.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Unfortunately, the Harbor is a little too busy this time of year. If I stay around the commotion for too long, my ears start to hurt.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: So, I came over here for a break.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno said he needed to be alone for a while to think about something.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He... came up with another joke...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Tighnari all about Cyno's envelope joke...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #Thanks for the warning, {NICKNAME}. At least I can mentally prepare myself this time...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Thanks again for the envelope — it's lovely. I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Bye! I'm going to look for Cyno. *sigh* Let's hope he's not feeling too inspired today...
